summary: Research complete for the Claude 1962 First Sunday of Advent. propers/verified.md fixes the exact 1962 Latin of all ten elements from 400-dpi page images, establishes the publication basis from Pustet 1862 page images (all ten elements in the same words), and gives Lasance 1945 English (read on page images) and the Douay display with every divergence stated. research/scope.md records the reception matrix (Gregory Hom. 1, Ambrose X, Augustine Ep. 199 and En. Ps. 24/84, Chrysostom Rom 24 and Mt 77, Cyril of Alexandria sermon 139, Cyril of Jerusalem Cat. 15, Bede, Aquinas Super Rom 13 l.3 and Super Ps 24, Bellarmine Ps 24/84), the liturgical commentators identified by element (Rupert III.2, Sicard Mitrale V, Durandus VI, Schuster pp. 320-323; Rupert/Sicard had Mt 21 as Gospel), six consequential difficulties, disagreements (station of Gregory's homily, Schuster's 'earthquake' vs Gregory's turbo, the Ps 84:13 earth/fruit dispute), negatives, leads, defects and bounds. research/interpretations.md proposes four readings (lift-up-your-heads; coming-through-the-church; hour-to-rise; mercy-shown-salvation-given), each with two Father/Doctor carriers. Chronology: added shared event life-of-christ.prophecies-in-the-temple-lucan-account (derived from the Olivet event, c. A.D. 29, with a Lucan Temple setting) plus its Lk 21:5-36 binding and orientation setting; record and orientation-v3 annotations written and --check current; scripture-chronology validate/build/check pass. context.md corrected in place (1862 Communion citation Ps. 84 on the image; Lasance prints English for all elements). source-library validate passes (56 bindings incl. 6 leads).
